sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): trotting forward, the fists at his chest gripping the purple ropes, the BIG BACKPACK bouncing on his back, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS AND HIS BACKPACK: the hands where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour) - gripping the purple ropes at his chest, punching, raised or flung wide as the pale figure holds them. THE PALE FIGURE HAS NO BACKPACK (his old sprite lacked it): ADD the big gourd-shaped backpack of image 1 ON HIS BACK IN EVERY FRAME, as big as in image 1, moving with his back - tilting as he leans, bouncing as he runs, on top of him when he lies face down - its purple rope over his shoulders. THE ROUND FIRE SPIRIT the pale figure shows behind his shoulder is NOT drawn: the game floats his spirit in by itself. Only him: no fireballs, no flames on his hands or feet, no fire rings, no sparks, no glow.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his brown sandal flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the hands and the backpack follow the pale figure. The backpack rides on his back: it never touches the ground while he runs.

THE PALE FIGURE HAS NO BACKPACK (his old sprite lacked it): ADD the big gourd-shaped backpack of image 1 ON HIS BACK IN EVERY FRAME, as big as in image 1, moving with his back - tilting as he leans, bouncing as he runs, on top of him when he lies face down - its purple rope over his shoulders. THE ROUND FIRE SPIRIT the pale figure shows behind his shoulder is NOT drawn: the game floats his spirit in by itself. Only him: no fireballs, no flames on his hands or feet, no fire rings, no sparks, no glow.
